title: SB752 (2024 Regular): Regulated Firearms - Maryland Voluntary Do Not Sell Firearm Process

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2024RS/bills/sb/sb0752f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader: the bill as filed. The 5–904(b) quote is the lead-in to items (1)-(4). The registry records are made confidential (General Provisions § 4–325.1) and a Tax-General disclosure is added; both support the registry. No passage vote in the record.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–134(b)): A dealer or other person may not sell, rent, loan, or transfer a regulated firearm to a purchaser, lessee, borrower, or transferee who the dealer or other person knows or has reasonable cause to believe: (15) IS REGISTERED ON THE MARYLAND VOLUNTARY DO NOT SELL FIREARM REGISTRY ESTABLISHED UNDER § 5–902 OF THIS TITLE;
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–902): ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 31, 2024, THE DEPARTMENT SHALL CREATE AND MAINTAIN THE MARYLAND VOLUNTARY DO NOT SELL FIREARM REGISTRY IN WHICH A PERSON MAY VOLUNTARILY ENROLL FOR THE PURPOSE OF BEING PROHIBITED FROM OBTAINING A REGULATED FIREARM.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–903(a)): A REGISTRY APPLICANT SHALL: (1) BE AT LEAST 18 YEARS OLD; AND (2) SUBMIT TO THE DEPARTMENT A REGISTRY APPLICATION ON THE FORM THAT THE SECRETARY PROVIDES.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–904(b)): PROMPTLY, BUT NOT SOONER THAN 21 DAYS AFTER RECEIVING A PROPERLY COMPLETED REQUEST FOR REMOVAL FROM THE REGISTRY, THE SECRETARY SHALL:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–905): A PERSON WHO VIOLATES THIS SECTION IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND ON CONVICTION IS SUBJECT TO IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 1 YEAR OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $1,000 OR BOTH.
